title: East Ramapo SLP pilot: workforce and credential operating plan
scope: One experienced in-person SLP plus a separately cleared backup; expand to at most three primary clinicians only against approved, funded assignments. This is our proposed pilot boundary, not a district volume commitment.
status: Research and proposed operating design. No candidates identified, approached, screened or hired; no individual credentials verified; no employer registrations completed.
planning_assumptions: Use the agency as the proposed W-2 employer; employment, entity and insurance arrangements require an accountable professional review before representations or payroll. Do not label workers independent contractors merely to reduce modeled costs.

Use already qualified, independently practicing school SLPs for initial capacity. Clinical fellows, assistants, teletherapy and OT/PT expansion are separate designs, not substitutions if recruiting is difficult.

The backup is a real second person with documented availability and accepted standby/activation terms; an applicant list is not guaranteed coverage. Reserve cost and any minimum paid commitment must be priced.
A named clinical lead oversees quality; this may be the experienced primary SLP if qualified and capacity allows. It does not create a statutory supervision requirement for every fully licensed SLP.
Public and nonpublic school sites may have different calendars, travel and onboarding. Do not promise a single-site job before the district confirms the assignment.

role_cards.employment_model: Proposed W-2, assignment and hours contingent on funded district order
role_cards.job: Deliver authorized school speech services in person; evaluate only when specifically authorized; attend agreed meetings; complete district clinical documentation; communicate missed services and safety concerns.
selection_preferences: Demonstrated independent school/IEP experience relevant to actual ages and needs. No invented minimum number of years.
Competence in assessment, progress documentation and culturally/linguistically appropriate practice; request de-identified or synthetic examples.
Reliability for confirmed sites/hours and ability to perform essential duties with reasonable accommodation.
Actual state-required education and district qualification evidence; CCC-SLP is verified if the candidate claims it or the final assignment requires it, not assumed universally mandatory.

role_cards.employment_model: Proposed W-2; written availability and paid activation/standby terms
role_cards.job: Cover only assignments and populations for which independently qualified and district-approved; receive the authorized plan and documented handoff before contact.
selection_preferences: Equivalent assignment-specific credentials, relevant clinical competence and clearance.
A feasible local travel plan and actual availability windows that do not overlap incompatible work.

role_cards.proposed_count: Named responsibility, not necessarily an additional FTE
role_cards.job: Human clinical review of competency, scope, complex cases, documentation and service concerns; coordinate with district clinical/IEP authorities.
role_cards.capacity_rule: Allocate and pay protected review time; do not count it twice as direct treatment and billable therapy. The role cannot be filled by an AI agent.

role_cards.proposed_count: Named responsibility; founder or retained service can cover appropriate portions
role_cards.job: Own hiring decisions, credential acceptance, district approvals, coverage escalation, employment notices and payroll release. Use separation or independent review where the treating clinician also holds an agency role.
role_cards.capacity_rule: Founder remains accountable for vendors and agents; payroll service and counsel are established specialist services.

requirements.title: Verify both professional and school authority
requirements.requirement: Agency SLPs need NY SLP licensure/current registration plus the applicable TSHH/TSSLD certificate. A bilingual IEP assignment also needs its bilingual extension; language fluency alone does not establish that credential.

requirements.title: Resolve entity and employer model
requirements.requirement: Education Law 8208 expressly permits corporate SLP/audiology practice through qualified people. Confirm the actual contracting/employer entity and any agency-license applicability; this SLP exception does not authorize OT/PT automatically.

requirements.title: District-linked school clearance
requirements.requirement: East Ramapo must coordinate the covered-school TEACH clearance request for agency personnel. A fingerprint appointment, receipt, prior credential or NYCPS clearance alone is insufficient proof of assignment readiness. Pilot policy requires full district-confirmed clearance before student contact, with no emergency shortcut.
requirements.owner: District Fingerprint Coordinator and agency HR

requirements.title: Finish current child-abuse training
requirements.requirement: NYSED sets November 17, 2026 for the second updated mandated-reporter curriculum. Pilot policy is to finish it before first student contact, even if that occurs earlier. Verify provider-reported completion; an old workshop certificate is not adequate evidence of this update.

requirements.title: Keep distinct credential renewal duties
requirements.requirement: Practicing SLPs generally complete 30 continuing-competency hours per three-year professional-registration cycle under NYSED rules. Separately verify educator certificate type, validity and applicable registration/CTLE duties. Do not copy professional CE into a generic school-renewal checkbox; resolve applicable exceptions.

requirements.title: Training and site handoff
requirements.requirement: Certification workshops include child abuse, DASA and violence prevention; the speech certificate path also includes autism training. Confirm actual TEACH evidence/applicability, and complete district-specific safety, reporting, privacy and system orientation. Employer harassment policy and annual training are separate. RFP page 16 separately requires the bidder to certify that its policy is already implemented and annual employee training is provided.

requirements.title: Bid named clinician capability honestly
requirements.requirement: Submit individual proposed-provider resumes/references, not leadership experience alone. Addendum permits later additions and assignments ranging from part-time sessions to leave coverage, but establishes no guaranteed work. Do not imply availability without the clinician agreeing to be proposed. Base RFP asks for IEP-child experience and state-required education; it states no minimum years or universal CCC requirement.

requirements.title: Establish W-2 employer operations
requirements.requirement: Obtain/verify EIN and NY employer registration; configure withholding, wage reporting and new-hire reporting. Confirm coverage and pay/leave policies with payroll/counsel. Reporting starts from compensated work, which may precede classroom service.

requirements.title: Give the correct wage notice
requirements.requirement: Resolve whether the firm meets the temporary-help definition and use the applicable pre-work wage notice/assignment procedure. Confirm workweek, pay frequency, overtime treatment, travel, training and cancellation pay. Client rejection of an invoice must not erase actual employee work.

requirements.title: Fair recruiting and transparent proposed terms
requirements.requirement: Do not ask for or rely on salary history. Publish a real approved pay range as pilot policy. NYDOL distinguishes client temporary-help assignments from internal agency jobs for the posting rule; do not describe all placements as legally identical.

requirements.title: Human clinical and hiring authority
requirements.requirement: People decide hiring, accommodations, professional eligibility and clinical matters. AI may organize authorized evidence and flag missing items; it may not diagnose, change an IEP, sign a therapy note, or make an adverse hiring decision.
requirements.owner: Hiring manager; treating therapist; district IEP authority

requirements.title: Readiness is assignment-specific
requirements.requirement: Before every start or substitute activation, approve the combination of person, school/site, schedule, service scope, credentials, current plan access and funded order. Unknown, pending and expired states block release; they are not equivalent to cleared.
requirements.owner: Agency operations owner and district service owner

requirements.kind: RFP requirement plus proposed review control
requirements.title: Monthly exclusions screening and timely notice
requirements.requirement: RFP page 15 requires at least monthly checks of all employees and subcontractors against federal EPLS/successor, HHS OIG and NY OMIG lists; written district notice within 3 days of an exclusion/ineligibility event or discovery. Potential name matches require prompt human identity review, not automatic rejection.
requirements.owner: Compliance owner and district contract owner

recruiting_plan.geography: Proposed search order: Rockland County first; then adjacent Westchester, Orange and northern Bergen County commuters who already hold the necessary NY credentials. These are search hypotheses, not evidence of available clinicians. Evaluate actual school-time travel and multi-site cost; do not impose residence or car-ownership requirements when another reliable travel method works.
recruiting_plan.channels: Prepare a role-specific job description and approved compensation band; use authorized professional job boards, voluntary applicant intake, professional referrals and experienced school-SLP communities. No postings, paid campaigns, messages or scraping of private profiles have been performed.
recruiting_plan.pipeline_targets: Proposed planning funnel, not a forecast: 8–12 qualified conversations, 4–6 human clinical interviews, two reference-complete finalists plus alternates. Do not put any unconsenting clinician in the bid or promise this funnel by October 30.
first_screen: Confirm the actual credential record and relevant experience; no citizenship, age, family-status or salary-history questions.
Explain in-person work, conditional assignment, known/unknown hours, site travel and compensation/benefit terms honestly.
Confirm interview accommodations, start-date constraints and consent to credential/reference verification.

interview_rubric.prompt: With a synthetic service plan, explain authorized work, missing information and who may change the plan.
interview_rubric.positive_evidence: Keeps district/IEP authority distinct; does not invent service frequency or eligibility.

interview_rubric.prompt: Discuss an appropriately de-identified school case and how assessment findings guided professional decisions.
interview_rubric.positive_evidence: Reasoned assessment and individualized intervention within scope; acknowledges limitations.

interview_rubric.prompt: Create a brief note from an artificial session and distinguish attendance, treatment and progress.
interview_rubric.positive_evidence: Accurate attestation without fabricated observations; clear privacy judgment.

interview_rubric.prompt: Explain how language difference, disability and interpreter/bilingual requirements affect the specific assignment.
interview_rubric.positive_evidence: Avoids unsupported assumptions; recognizes when another qualification or support is necessary.

interview_rubric.prompt: Respond to a cancellation, a safety concern and a plan mismatch.
interview_rubric.positive_evidence: Documents and escalates promptly through appropriate channels; does not unilaterally prescribe compensatory services.

interview_rubric.prompt: Walk through a realistic site-day schedule including documentation, meetings and travel.
interview_rubric.positive_evidence: Feasible availability and workload; no overlapping commitments or double-counted service time.

recruiting_plan.decision_method: Human clinical lead and hiring manager record supported / needs clarification / not yet supported against the same job-related criteria. No automated ranking, facial/voice/personality scoring or proxy protected-class inference. Resolve accommodations and lawful background issues through approved human processes.

onboarding_sequence.exit: Receipt and immutable packet retained; award or an assignment is not inferred from submission.

onboarding_sequence.exit: District-confirmed clearance plus employer readiness; compensation starts according to actual work performed.

backup_protocol.planned_absence: Confirm availability, district acceptance and exact scope; schedule paid handoff/preparation where required. Backup gains only necessary assignment access. Do not silently treat them as the original provider.
backup_protocol.same_day_absence: Agent alerts operations and drafts impacted-session list; human contacts the district through agreed channels. Offer the already cleared backup only if actually available and approved for the assignment.
backup_protocol.no_available_backup: Report unfilled work honestly and preserve missed-service evidence. The district/IEP process decides educational remedy; no automated makeup or compensatory-service determination.
backup_protocol.commercial_rule: Choose and price a real availability arrangement: paid scheduled reserve, limited standby retainer or explicitly non-guaranteed on-call. Employment counsel/payroll determine compensable on-call restrictions. Do not promise guaranteed coverage for an unpaid name on a roster.
backup_protocol.access_rule: Log handoff, new clinician attestation and any change of record access; revoke access when coverage ends.

employer_decisions_before_offer.question: Which entity signs, employs, pays, invoices and retains professional responsibility; does employment-agency licensing or another registration apply to this exact arrangement?

What is the approved pay basis and workweek, applicable exemption/nonexempt treatment, overtime aggregation across assignments, pay frequency and treatment of travel, training, meetings, preparation, cancellations and standby?

What headcount/income tests and eligibility govern sick leave, paid prenatal leave, disability/PFL and other benefits; what additional benefits make the offer viable? School closure alone is not a complete pay rule.
Does the bound employer coverage include the actual personnel, sites and duties, and does it meet the district packet? Reconcile separately with the insurance workstream.
Who completes I-9, wage notices, taxes and new-hire reporting and stores them in restricted systems; who handles errors and legal holds?

If a mandatory credential, clearance or provider availability is missing at the commercial deadline, which scope is withdrawn or held? Do not replace a missing SLP with an assistant/CF or change to teletherapy.

human_agent_boundary.human_must: Resolve disputed work/classification and authorize payroll release independent of invoice collection.

open_evidence: Actual company entity, registrations, experience and professional/employer arrangements.
Named consenting clinicians, qualifications, references, availability, expected pay and backup terms.
Current complete bid/addenda requirements and district acceptance of proposed personnel/coverage.
Exact district clearance initiation, authorized private-school sites and site orientation requirements.
Actual funded assignments, school calendars, caseload/schedule, travel and student/service documentation systems.
Bound employer/professional insurance, benefit design and working-capital capacity.
Named human owners for every clinical, HR, compliance, payroll and district approval; roles above are not filled merely because the plan names them.

A qualified name without accepted availability, district clearance and handoff cannot be activated.

Undelivered therapy remains undelivered while actual preparation/travel/documentation work is preserved for approved payroll treatment.
A bid submission or award cannot create guaranteed clinician work hours or a payable district assignment.
